blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/CivilBench.
blocks.zh: 人工智能(AI),特别是大型语言模型(LLM)和视觉语言模型(VLMs),越来越多地被应用于民用和结构工程,用于灾害评估,结构分析和工程决策支持. 然而,目前的甚高压材料在多大程度上具备可靠的工程判断所需的推理能力仍然不清楚。 在这项工作中,我们引入了Civil Bench,这是在土木工程和与灾害有关的情景中评估自愿地雷影响的综合基准。 Civil Bench涵盖三大任务领域:顺序理性、基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解,包括数字推理、结构损害评估、风险推断、因果分析和修复规划。 基准是通过一个系统化的专门域数据收集、面向工程的说明、专家注释、问题设计和质量核查的管道构建的。 对有代表性的最新VLM的评价揭示出特定领域推理的严重局限性,序列理性成为主要瓶颈,特别是当模型必须从稀少的结构化观测中推断出数字关系时. 进一步的实验表明,数字前科和外部知识可以减轻这些局限性,尽管其有效性取决于模型可靠地解释和使用现有证据的能力. Civil Bench提供了一个面向能力的试验台,用于确定推理局限性并评估实现可靠的AI辅助工程决策的进展情况。 该基准将在https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/Civil Bench上公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) [ 9 , 45 ] and vision-language models (VLMs) [ 37 , 29 , 62 ] have substantially expanded the capability of artificial intelligence systems to jointly process visual and textual information. By aligning perceptual inputs with high-level semantic reasoning, these models have achieved remarkable performance on a wide range of multimodal tasks, including visual question answering [ 3 ] , image captioning [ 54 , 60 ] , cross-modal retrieval [ 58 ] , and interactive visual reasoning [ 49 ] . More importantly, the rapid progress of VLMs has opened new opportunities for applying AI to knowledge-intensive and decision-oriented domains [ 46 , 31 ] , where visual evidence must be interpreted together with contextual and professional knowledge. As a result, VLMs are increasingly being explored in areas such as healthcare [ 43 ] , marine science [ 59 ] , scientific analysis [ 8 ] , industrial inspection [ 56 ] , and decision support systems [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型[9,45]和视觉语言模型[37,29,62]的近期进步,大大扩大了人工智能系统联合处理视觉和文字信息的能力. 这些模型通过使概念输入与高级语义推理一致,在广泛的多式联运任务上取得了显著的性能,包括视觉问题回答[3],图像标题[54,60],跨模式检索[58],互动视觉推理[49]. 更重要的是,VLMs的迅速进步为将AI应用到知识密集型和以决策为导向的领域[46,31]提供了新的机会,视觉证据必须与背景和专业知识一起解释。 因此,在保健[43]、海洋科学[59]、科学分析[8]、工业检查[56]、决策支持系统[44]等领域,正在越来越多地探索自愿临界值。

blocks.en:
Civil and structural engineering represents one of the most important yet underexplored domains for VLM-based intelligence. Engineering practice often involves interpreting complex visual observations [ 51 ] , analyzing structural conditions [ 36 ] , assessing potential risks [ 21 ] , and making decisions under uncertainty [ 22 ] .
Reliable VLMs have the potential to support infrastructure inspection [ 27 ] ,
post-disaster assessment [ 12 ] ,
and structural monitoring [ 39 , 50 ] .
By integrating visual, textual, and quantitative information, these models may improve the efficiency and consistency of engineering assessment and decision-making [ 17 ] .
Such capabilities are especially valuable in safety-critical scenarios, where timely and accurate analysis can support disaster response, reduce inspection costs, and enhance the resilience of infrastructure systems. However, whether current VLMs can truly perform as reliable civil engineering assistants remains an open question [ 40 , 6 ] . Unlike general multimodal tasks, civil engineering problems require professional domain knowledge, physical intuition, numerical reasoning, and mechanism-level understanding of materials, loads, damage evolution, and structural behavior.
blocks.zh:
土木工程和结构工程是基于VLM的情报中最重要的但探索不足的领域之一。 工程实践往往涉及解释复杂的视觉观测[51],分析结构条件[36],评估潜在风险[21],并在不确定性[22]下作出决定。
可靠的甚高频有可能支持基础设施检查[27],
灾后评估[12],
和结构监测[39、50]
通过整合视觉、文字和定量信息,这些模型可以提高工程评估和决策的效率和一致性[17]。
这种能力在安全关键情景中特别宝贵,在这些情景中,及时和准确的分析可以支持救灾,降低检查费用,并提高基础设施系统的复原力。 然而,目前的VLM是否能够真正作为可靠的土木工程助理发挥作用仍然是一个有待解决的问题[40,6]. 与一般的多式联运任务不同,土木工程问题需要专业领域知识,物理直觉,数值推理,以及机制层面对材料,负载,损害演化,结构行为的理解.

blocks.en:
Despite the growing interest in applying multimodal AI to specialized domains, existing VLM evaluations remain insufficient for civil and structural engineering. Most established benchmarks focus on general-purpose multimodal understanding, including visual question answering [ 3 ] , compositional visual reasoning [ 23 ] , and multidisciplinary multimodal understanding [ 55 ] .
These evaluations rarely capture the requirements of engineering practice, such as interpreting damage severity , identifying failure mechanisms , reasoning over temporal structural responses , estimating quantitative indicators , and recommending appropriate repair or mitigation actions . Moreover, engineering scenarios frequently involve noisy and heterogeneous visual data, partial occlusions, complex spatial layouts, domain-specific terminology, and physical constraints that are absent from generic datasets. Consequently, strong performance on existing benchmarks does not necessarily imply professional reliability in civil engineering contexts [ 53 ] . This mismatch leaves a critical gap: we still lack a rigorous and domain-specific benchmark for understanding whether VLMs can support trustworthy engineering reasoning and decision-making.
blocks.zh:
尽管人们越来越有兴趣在专门领域采用多式人工智能,但现有的对民用和结构工程的虚拟LM评价仍然不足。 大多数既定基准侧重于通用多式联运理解,包括视觉问题回答[3]、构成视觉推理[23]和多学科多式联运理解[55]。
这些评价很少反映工程实践的要求,如解释损害的严重程度、确定故障机制、对时间结构反应的推理、估计定量指标以及建议适当的修复或缓解行动。 此外,工程情景往往涉及噪音和多样性的视觉数据、部分隐含、复杂的空间布局、特定域的术语以及通用数据集所缺少的物理限制。 因此,在现有基准方面的良好业绩并不一定意味着土木工程方面的专业可靠性[53]。 这种不匹配留下了一个关键的缺口:我们仍然缺乏一个严格的和针对特定领域的基准来理解VLM是否能够支持值得信赖的工程推理和决策.

blocks.en: Directly evaluating VLMs in civil engineering is challenging because meaningful assessment must go beyond visual recognition [ 24 ] . A model may correctly identify cracks, corrosion, or deformation from the visual observations, but still fail to infer the underlying cause, evaluate the associated risk, or suggest a feasible repair strategy. Similarly, numerical answers in engineering are not isolated values; they often reflect physical consistency, temporal evolution, structural constraints, and professional judgment. Therefore, a useful and practical benchmark should not only test whether a model can describe 1) what is visible, but also 2) whether it can reason about why it occurs, 3) how severe it is, 4) what consequences it may have, and 5) what actions should be taken. Such evaluation is essential for distinguishing superficial multimodal understanding from genuine engineering intelligence.
blocks.zh: 直接评价 土木工程中的VLM具有挑战性,因为有意义的评估必须超越视觉识别[24]. 模型可能从视觉观测中正确识别裂缝、腐蚀或变形,但仍无法推断其根本原因、评估相关风险或建议可行的修复策略。 同样,工程中的数字答案并不是孤立的价值观;它们往往反映物理一致性、时间演变、结构限制和专业判断。 因此,一个有用和实用的基准不仅应当检验一个模型是否能够描述1)什么是可见的,而且还应当检验2)它是否能够解释它发生的原因,3)它有多严重,4)它可能带来什么后果,5)应该采取何种行动. 这种评价对于区分表面的多式联运理解和真正的工程智能至关重要。

blocks.en: To address this need, we introduce CivilBench, the first large-scale benchmark specifically designed to evaluate VLMs in civil and structural engineering scenarios. As illustrated in Figure 1 , CivilBench provides a comprehensive testbed covering diverse visual, structured, and knowledge-intensive evaluation scenarios. It spans multiple task families and capability dimensions, including sequential numerical reasoning, temporal analysis, structural damage understanding, risk inference, failure-cause analysis, mechanism-level interpretation, and repair or mitigation suggestion. By integrating both fundamental perception and open-world expert reasoning, CivilBench enables a systematic assessment of the gap between general multimodal understanding and professional engineering judgment. Beyond serving as a benchmark for model comparison, CivilBench is intended to support the broader development of AI-assisted civil engineering systems, including infrastructure inspection, disaster assessment, structural health monitoring, safety evaluation, and intelligent decision support.
blocks.zh: 为了满足这一需要,我们引入了Civil Bench,这是第一个专门用来评估土木和结构工程情景中的VLM的大规模基准. 如图1所示,Civil Bench提供了一个涵盖各种视觉、结构化和知识密集型评价情景的综合试验台。 它涉及多个任务领域和能力层面,包括顺序数字推理、时间分析、结构损害理解、风险推论、故障原因分析、机制层面的解释以及修复或缓解建议。 Civil Bench将基本认识和开放世界的专家推理结合起来,从而能够系统地评估一般多式联运理解与专业工程判断之间的差距。 除了作为模型比较的基准外,Civil Bench还旨在支持更广泛地发展AI辅助的土木工程系统,包括基础设施检查,灾害评估,结构健康监测,安全评价,以及智能决策支持.

blocks.en: A key strength of CivilBench lies in its scientifically grounded and comprehensive dataset construction process. Rather than simply collecting image-question pairs, we design a structured pipeline that emphasizes engineering validity, annotation reliability, and practical relevance. The construction process includes domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, task-driven question generation, expert-guided annotation, and multi-stage quality verification. Each sample is designed to reflect realistic engineering scenarios and professional reasoning workflows, ensuring that the benchmark evaluates not only visual understanding but also domain-specific inference and decision-making. This careful design allows CivilBench to cover a wide range of engineering conditions, task difficulties, and reasoning types, making it both practically meaningful and analytically informative.
blocks.zh: Civil Bench的一个关键优势在于其基于科学的综合数据集构建过程。 我们设计了一个结构化的管道, 它强调工程的有效性、注释的可靠性和实用性。 施工过程包括特定领域数据收集、面向工程的说明、任务驱动的提问生成、专家指导的说明以及多阶段质量核查。 每个样本都旨在反映现实的工程情景和专业推理工作流程,确保基准不仅评价视觉理解,而且评价特定领域的推论和决策. 这种细心的设计使得Civil Bench能够涵盖广泛的工程条件,任务困难,推理类型,使其既具有实际意义,又具有分析性的信息.

blocks.en: We further develop unified and scalable evaluation protocols for heterogeneous task types, including quantitative prediction, ordinal comparison, damage assessment, risk inference, and mechanism-level reasoning. These protocols are designed to be both scientifically solid and intuitively interpretable, enabling fair comparison across different VLMs while providing detailed diagnostic insights into their strengths and weaknesses. Through extensive benchmarking of representative state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that current models still struggle with domain-specific civil engineering tasks. In particular, they exhibit limitations in physical reasoning, numerical prediction, temporal understanding, failure-mode interpretation, and reliable decision support. These findings highlight the substantial gap between general-purpose VLMs and trustworthy engineering expertise, and point to important directions for future research in domain-aware multimodal intelligence. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们进一步为各种任务类型制定统一和可扩展的评价协议,包括定量预测、平面比较、损害评估、风险推断和机制级推理。 这些协议的设计既具有科学的坚实性,又具有直观的解释性,能够公平比较不同脆弱LM,同时对其优缺点提供详细的诊断性见解。 通过对具有代表性的最先进的VLM的广泛基准化,我们发现,目前的模型仍然在与特定领域的土木工程任务作斗争。 特别是,它们在物理推理、数值预测、时间理解、故障模式解释和可靠的决策支持方面显示出局限性。 这些结论突出表明了通用甚高频和可信赖的工程专门知识之间的巨大差距,并指明了未来在具有域意识的多式联运情报方面开展研究的重要方向。 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • Capability-oriented evaluation. We introduce CivilBench, a benchmark that moves beyond generic image–text understanding to systematically assess the engineering reasoning capabilities of VLMs. Rather than relying solely on aggregate accuracy, CivilBench enables fine-grained diagnosis of how models interpret structured observations, understand structural conditions, and make domain-grounded judgments. • Unified engineering benchmark. CivilBench integrates three task families and 14 capability dimensions, spanning sparse numerical and sequential reasoning, image-based structural understanding, and open-world engineering inference. Built through domain-specific data collection, expert annotation, and quality verification, it provides a unified testbed for examining the gap between multimodal perception and engineering reasoning. • Reasoning bottlenecks and evidence utilization. Extensive evaluation of representative VLMs identifies Sequential Reasoning as a major bottleneck, particularly in inferring numerical relationships from limited observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can improve performance, while exposing the challenges of reliably aligning retrieved evidence with engineering tasks.

The remainder of this paper is organized as follows.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 VLMs for Understanding and Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.1 用于理解和说明理由的VLM

blocks.en: Recent VLMs have advanced multimodal reasoning by coupling visual encoders with LLMs, enabling open-ended responses grounded in images. They perform well on tasks such as visual question answering [ 3 ] , captioning [ 2 ] , retrieval [ 37 ] , and interactive reasoning [ 29 ] , showing strong ability to align visual perception with semantic knowledge. However, these capabilities are mostly demonstrated on generic visual concepts, commonsense reasoning, and web-scale image-text associations [ 37 ] . Civil and structural engineering present a more demanding setting [ 53 , 11 ] . Engineering tasks require recognizing subtle structural conditions, comparing damage evolution, interpreting quantitative information, and linking observations to physical mechanisms such as material degradation, load transfer, and failure modes [ 25 , 24 ] . These requirements go beyond visual recognition and demand domain knowledge, numerical consistency, and safety-aware reasoning. Since most VLMs are trained on broad web data with limited engineering supervision, they may generate plausible but physically inconsistent or professionally unreliable responses. This motivates dedicated evaluation of whether VLMs can support mechanism-aware and decision-oriented reasoning in civil engineering.
blocks.zh: 近期的VLM通过将视觉编码器与LLMs结合,使得基于图像的开放式响应得以推进多式联运推理. 它们在诸如视觉问题回答[3],字幕[2],检索[37],以及交互式推理[29]等任务上表现良好,显示出将视觉感知与语义知识相配合的强大能力. 然而,这些能力大多表现在通用视觉概念,常识推理,以及网络尺度的图像文本关联[37]. 土木工程和结构工程提供了一个更严格的环境[53,11]。 工程任务需要识别微妙的结构条件,比较损害演变,解释定量信息,并将观测与物质退化,负载转移,故障模式等物理机制联系起来[25,24]. 这些要求超出了视觉识别和要求域知识、数字一致性和安全意识推理的范围。 由于大多数甚高频数据是在有限的工程监督下接受广泛的网络数据培训的,因此,它们可能会产生可信的、但实际上不一致或专业上不可靠的反应。 这促使人们专门评估VLM是否能够支持土木工程中具有机制意识和决策导向的推理.

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarking VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 制定自愿活动基准

blocks.en:
Evaluating VLMs is challenging because their outputs are often open-ended, multimodal, and sensitive to prompts. Benchmarks such as VQAv2 [ 3 ] , GQA [ 23 ] , and ScienceQA [ 31 ] support structured evaluation, while SEED-Bench [ 28 ] , MMMU [ 55 ] , and MMBench [ 30 ] ) assess broader multimodal capabilities.
However, these benchmarks are mainly designed for general-purpose evaluation and do not fully reflect civil engineering requirements. Civil engineering evaluation requires more than semantic correctness. Model responses must also be numerically consistent, physically plausible, temporally coherent, and useful for decision-making. A model may identify visible damage but fail to infer its severity, cause, risk, or proper intervention. Moreover, engineering tasks involve heterogeneous formats, including numerical prediction, ordinal comparison, visual diagnosis, and open-ended expert reasoning, making unified evaluation difficult [ 57 ] . CivilBench addresses these challenges through capability-oriented task design and standardized evaluation protocols, enabling systematic and intuitive assessment of VLMs in sequential reasoning, structural understanding, and open-world engineering decision-making.
blocks.zh:
评估VLM具有挑战性,因为其产出往往是开放式的、多式联运的,而且对提示敏感。 VQAv2[3],GQA[23],ScienceQA[31]等基准支持结构化评价,而SEED-Bench[28],MMMU[55],MMBench[30]等基准则评估更广泛的多式联运能力.
然而,这些基准主要是为普通用途评价设计的,没有充分反映土木工程的要求。 土木工程评价要求的不仅仅是语义正确. 示范对策还必须在数量上一致,在实际上合理,在时间上一致,并对决策有用。 模型可以确定明显的损害,但不能推断其严重程度、原因、风险或适当的干预。 此外,工程任务涉及不同格式,包括数字预测、平面比较、视觉诊断和不限成员名额的专家推理,使统一评价变得困难 [57] 。 Civil Bench通过面向能力的任务设计和标准化评价协议,在顺序推理、结构理解和开放世界的工程决策中,能够系统、直观地评估脆弱LM,来应对这些挑战。

blocks.en: 2.3 Civil and Structural Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.3 民用和结构数据集

blocks.en:
Existing civil and structural engineering datasets mainly focus on perception tasks such as crack detection [ 63 , 26 ] , corrosion recognition [ 34 ] ,
pavement distress classification [ 33 ] , bridge inspection [ 16 , 7 ] ,
and post-disaster damage assessment [ 19 , 38 ] . These datasets typically provide image-level labels, bounding boxes, segmentation masks, or damage categories, and have been useful for training computer vision models to identify visible defects [ 32 ] . Recent multimodal benchmarks introduce textual descriptions or
question-answer pairs, but their evaluations mainly address descriptive understanding [ 31 ] , object recognition [ 30 ] ,
or attribute queries [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh:
现有的土木和结构工程数据集主要侧重于诸如裂缝探测[63,26],腐蚀识别[34],
人行道危难分类[33],桥检[16,7],
和灾后损害评估[19、38] 这些数据集通常提供图像级别标签,边框,分块口罩,或损坏类别,并一直用于培训计算机视觉模型以识别明显的缺陷[32]. 最近的多式联运基准采用了文字说明或
问答对等,但其评价主要涉及描述性理解[31],对象识别[30],
或属性查询 [18].

blocks.en:
Despite recent advances, two key research gaps remain.
First, existing benchmarks lack a systematic assessment of VLM capabilities in civil and structural engineering,
particularly in quantitative reasoning, engineering inference, and multimodal alignment. Current civil engineering datasets
primarily focus on damage recognition, with limited coverage of higher-level engineering tasks.
Second, existing evaluations are often limited to individual tasks, making it difficult to compare model performance
across different engineering capabilities and identify their specific strengths and weaknesses.
To address these gaps, CivilBench integrates visual and quantitative tasks within a unified evaluation framework, supported by
visual necessity testing, expert verification, and standardized evaluation protocols. By identifying capability limitations
across engineering tasks, CivilBench also provides insights for future VLM development in civil engineering.
blocks.zh:
尽管最近取得了进展,但仍然存在两个关键的研究差距。
第一,现有基准缺乏对土木工程和结构工程中甚高频能力的系统评估,
特别是在定量推理、工程推论和多式联运方面。 当前土木工程数据集
主要侧重于损害的确认,对更高层次的工程任务的覆盖面有限。
第二,现有评价往往局限于个别任务,因此难以比较示范业绩
查明其具体的优缺点。
为了弥补这些差距,Civil Bench将视觉和定量任务纳入一个统一的评价框架内,并得到以下支持:
视觉必要性测试、专家核查和标准化评价协议。 通过确定能力限制
Civil Bench也为未来土木工程的VLM发展提供了见解。

blocks.en: 3 CivilBench
blocks.zh: 3 民用奔驰

blocks.en: This section introduces the design and construction of CivilBench. We first describe the benchmark design principles and the dataset construction process, including data collection, annotation, and quality control. We then present the task taxonomy and evaluation dimensions used to assess different engineering capabilities. Finally, we report the dataset statistics, task distribution, and image characteristics.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Civil Bench的设计和建造. 我们首先描述了基准设计原则和数据集构建过程,包括数据收集、注释和质量控制。 然后,我们介绍用于评估不同工程能力的任务分类和评估方面。 最后,我们报告数据集统计、任务分布和图像特征。

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Design Principles
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准设计原则

blocks.en: CivilBench is designed to assess VLMs under realistic civil and structural engineering constraints, where reliable reasoning requires visual evidence, domain consistency, and objective evaluation. Our construction is motivated by the limitations of generic multimodal benchmarks, which may overestimate model capability through language priors, ambiguous questions, or subjective scoring. To provide a scientifically grounded benchmark, CivilBench follows three key principles. • Visual grounding . Each question must rely on visual inputs, such as structural conditions, damage patterns, component states, or surrounding context. Text-only validation identifies and removes samples answerable without visual evidence, ensuring that CivilBench evaluates genuine image-based engineering reasoning rather than linguistic shortcuts. • Evaluation clarity . To reduce ambiguity, evaluation tasks are formulated with deterministic ground truth and constrained outputs, including classification, ranking, ordinal comparison, and multiple-choice formats. This design preserves engineering relevance while enabling objective and consistent comparison across models. • Reproducibility . Although expert knowledge is incorporated during annotation and verification, model evaluation relies only on fixed labels and predefined metrics. This removes variability from human scoring and supports stable benchmarking across models and experimental settings. These three designed principles ensure that CivilBench is visually grounded, professionally relevant, and reproducible, while establishing the methodological basis for the dataset construction pipeline and task-specific evaluation protocols presented in the following sections.
blocks.zh: Civil Bench旨在在现实的土木和结构工程限制下评估VLM,其中可靠的推理需要视觉证据,域一致性,以及客观的评价. 我们的构建受到通用多式联运基准的限制,这些基准可能会通过语言前题、模棱两可的问题或主观评分,高估模型能力。 为了提供科学依据的基准,Civil Bench遵循三项关键原则。 • 视觉地面。 每个问题必须依赖视觉输入,如结构条件,损坏模式,组件状态,或周围环境. 只文本验证在没有视觉证据的情况下识别和移除可回答的样本,确保Civil Bench评价真实的基于图像的工程推理而不是语言快捷键. • 评价的清晰度。 为了减少模糊性,制定评价任务时采用了确定性的基础真理和有限的产出,包括分类、排名、平面比较和多种选择格式。 这种设计保持了工程的相关性,同时能够客观和一致地在模型之间进行比较。 • 可复制性。 虽然在注释和核实过程中纳入了专家知识,但模型评价仅依靠固定标签和预先界定的衡量标准。 这消除了人类评分中的变异性,支持在模型和实验环境之间稳定的基准化. 这三项设计的原则确保了Civil Bench具有视觉基础、专业相关性和可复制性,同时为以下各节提出的数据集建设管道和具体任务评价规程奠定了方法基础。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集建设

blocks.en: Following the above principles, CivilBench is constructed through a multi-stage pipeline that prioritizes engineering validity, visual dependence, and evaluation consistency. The overall construction workflow is illustrated in Figure 2 . Rather than merely collecting image–question pairs, the dataset evaluates whether models can reason from structural evidence in realistic civil engineering scenarios.
blocks.zh: 遵循上述原则,Civil Bench是通过一个多阶段管道构建的,该管道优先考虑工程有效性,视觉依赖性,评价一致性. 图2说明了整个建筑工作流程。 数据集并非仅仅收集图像-问题对,而是评价模型是否能够在现实的土木工程情景中从结构证据中推理.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the CivilBench construction pipeline: (a) data collection, (b) visual necessity test, and (c) final filtering.
blocks.zh: 图2:民用奔驰建筑管道概述:(a)数据收集,(b)视觉必要性测试,(c)最后过滤。

blocks.en: Data collection. Figure 2 (a) illustrates the initial data collection stage. CivilBench integrates heterogeneous data from both public and private sources, including raw images and structured engineering records, to support both sequential reasoning and image-based structural understanding. For Sequential Reasoning Tasks, public tabular and textual resources describing hazard, exposure, and risk-related variables are combined with project-specific experimental records. These data are organized into pseudo-temporal sequences to support classification, ordinal comparison, and change detection. All data were manually screened and annotated by the authors. Publicly available data are used in accordance with their applicable licenses and terms of use. For third-party data without explicit redistribution permission, only derived annotations and metadata will be released where permitted.
blocks.zh: 数据收集。 图2(a)显示了初步数据收集阶段。 Civil Bench综合了来自公共和私人来源的不同数据,包括原始图像和结构工程记录,以支持顺序推理和基于图像的结构理解。 对于顺序性理性任务,描述危害、暴露和风险相关变量的公共表格和文字资源与具体项目的实验记录相结合。 这些数据被组织成伪时序,以支持分类,平面比较,以及变化检测. 所有数据均由作者人工筛选和注释。 根据其适用的许可证和使用条件使用公开的数据。 对于没有明确再分配许可的第三方数据,如果允许,将只发布衍生说明和元数据.

blocks.en: For image-based tasks, we collect samples from structural inspection datasets, disaster-related datasets, and publicly available web images using curated civil engineering keywords. The images cover diverse scenarios, including cracking, spalling, collapse, slope failure, and other infrastructure damage, with variations in scale, viewpoint, scene complexity, and image quality. This design introduces realistic visual heterogeneity and domain shift beyond conventional natural-image benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 对于以图像为基础的任务,我们从结构检查数据集,灾害相关数据集中收集样本,并使用整理的土木工程关键词,公开提供网络图像. 图像涵盖各种情景,包括裂缝、溅射、崩塌、坡度故障和其他基础设施损坏,其规模、视线、场景复杂性和图像质量各不相同。 这种设计引入了现实的视觉异质性和域位转移,超越了传统的自然形象基准.

blocks.en: Question construction and annotation . CivilBench follows two aligned annotation protocols. For Sequential Reasoning Tasks, records are grouped into short context-query sequences. The context contains labeled observations, while the query requires predicting a target label, comparing severity, or detecting change. This “context-to-query” formulation encourages relational and temporal reasoning rather than reliance on isolated label priors. For multiple-choice visual question answering (MC-VQA) tasks, each image is paired with domain-specific questions and four mutually exclusive answers. Questions cover predefined capabilities, including event recognition, damage assessment, geometry analysis, material identification, region grounding, hazard inference, cause analysis, and repair recommendations. Consistent engineering terminology ensures that answers are visually grounded and objectively verifiable.
blocks.zh: 问题建设与注释. Civil Bench遵循两个对齐的注释协议. 对于序列性理性任务,记录被分组为短上下文-query序列. 上下文包含有标签的观察,而查询则需要预测一个目标标签,比较严重程度,或检测变化. 这种“从文字到文字”的提法鼓励关系和时间推理,而不是依赖孤立的标签前科。 对于多选择视觉问题回答(MC-VQA)任务,每个图像都与特定域的问题和四个相互排斥的答案对齐. 问题涵盖预先确定的能力,包括事件识别、损害评估、几何分析、材料识别、区域定位、危险推断、原因分析和修复建议。 一致的工程术语确保答案有目视依据和客观可核查。

blocks.en: Visual necessity test. The visual necessity test is illustrated in Figure 2 (b). To prevent language-only shortcuts, all image-based question-answer candidates are evaluated by removing the associated image while retaining the question and answer options. Samples that can be answered correctly without visual information are discarded. This filtering step ensures that the remaining samples genuinely require visual evidence, reducing the influence of prior knowledge, textual cues, or option-level bias.
blocks.zh: 视觉必要性测试。 图2(b)说明了视觉必要性测试。 为防止只使用语言的快捷键,所有基于图像的问答考生都会在保留问答选项的同时通过删除相关图像来评价. 没有视觉信息可以正确回答的样本会被丢弃. 这一过滤步骤确保了剩余样本真正需要视觉证据,减少先前知识、文字提示或选项级偏差的影响。

blocks.en: Expert verification and final formatting. The final stage of the pipeline is illustrated in Figure 2 (c). After visual necessity filtering, structural engineering experts review each sample for correctness, clarity, and engineering consistency. Ambiguous, misleading, or technically inaccurate samples are revised or removed. The remaining samples are then organized into a unified format consisting of the input image or sequence, question, candidate answers, and ground-truth label. This process ensures a consistent benchmark for reliable evaluation of VLMs in civil engineering.
blocks.zh: 专家核查和最后格式化。 管道的最后阶段见图2(c)。 经过视觉必要性过滤后,结构工程专家对每个样本进行正确性,清晰度,工程一致性的审查. 修改或删除含混、误导性或技术上不准确的样本。 其余的样本随后编成一个统一格式,包括输入图像或序列、问题、候选答案和地面真实标签。 这一过程确保了在土木工程中可靠地评估VLM的一致基准。

blocks.en: 3.3 Capability-Oriented Task Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.3 面向任务的分类

blocks.en: CivilBench is organized around a capability-oriented taxonomy that reflects the progression from structural perception to engineering reasoning and decision support, as illustrated in Figure 3 . The benchmark consists of three task categories, which are described below: • Sequential Reasoning evaluates temporal structural cognition by requiring models to infer future states, compare relative severity, or detect condition changes from limited historical observations. These tasks reflect degradation tracking and temporal consistency, which are essential for structural health monitoring. • Image-based Structural Understanding assesses inspection capabilities from single images, including event detection, damage counting and coverage estimation, geometric pattern recognition, material identification, and region grounding. These tasks test whether models can extract reliable structural information from complex scenes. • Open-world Understanding targets higher-level reasoning beyond direct perception. It includes hazard inference, cause analysis, explanation assessment, image-text alignment, and repair suggestion. These tasks require models to integrate visual evidence with engineering knowledge, making them closer to real-world diagnostic and decision-support scenarios. These three categories provide a structured evaluation of VLMs across perception, temporal reasoning, domain knowledge, and practical engineering judgment.
blocks.zh: Civil Bench是围绕一种注重能力的分类法组织的,它反映了从结构感知到工程推理和决策支持的发展,如图3所示。 基准包括以下三个任务类别: · 序列理性通过要求模型推断未来状态,比较相对严重性,或从有限的历史观测中检测条件变化,来评价时间结构认知. 这些任务反映了退化跟踪和时间一致性,这对于结构性健康监测至关重要。 · 基于图像的结构理解从单一图像中评估检查能力,包括事件探测、损害计数和覆盖度估计、几何模式识别、材料识别和区域地面定位。 这些任务检验模型是否能够从复杂的场景中提取可靠的结构信息. · 开放世界理解的目标不仅仅是直接认识,而是更高级别的推理。 它包括危险推论、原因分析、解释评估、图像文本校正以及修复建议。 这些任务需要模型将视觉证据与工程知识相结合,使其更接近于现实世界的诊断和决策支持情景. 这三个类别提供了从认知、时间推理、域知识和实用工程判断的角度对VLM的结构性评价。

blocks.zh: 3.5 数据集统计和具体特征

blocks.en: Table 1: Capability-oriented evaluation dimensions in CivilBench.
blocks.zh: 表1:民用奔驰中面向能力的评价方面。

blocks.en: CivilBench is initially constructed with 1,000 carefully curated samples across Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding. Before evaluation, samples with invalid formatting, inconsistent annotations, missing assets, or processing failures are excluded to ensure reliable reporting. The final evaluated subset contains 972 valid samples: 285 Sequential Reasoning samples, consisting of 110 Classification, 90 Ordinal Reasoning, and 85 Change Detection samples; 286 Image-based Structural Understanding samples; and 401 Open-world Understanding samples. All experimental results and distribution-weighted Total scores are computed on this final evaluated subset. Image-based tasks adopt a single-choice MC-VQA format, where each sample contains an image, a question, four candidate answers, and one correct label. Sequential Reasoning Tasks use grouped pseudo-temporal records, enabling temporal classification, ordinal reasoning, and change detection under limited historical context.
blocks.zh: Civil Bench最初是用1000个精心整理的样本构建的,它们跨越了序列理性,基于图像的结构理解,以及开放世界的理解. 在评价前,排除格式无效、说明不一致、资产缺失或处理失败的样本,以确保可靠的报告。 最终评估的子集包含972个有效样本: 285 序因子标本,包括110个分类,90个正因子标本,85个变化检测标本;286个基于图像的结构理解标本;401个开放世界理解标本. 所有实验结果和分配加权总分均根据最后评价的子集计算。 基于图像的任务采用单选择的MC-VQA格式,每个样本包含一个图像,一个问题,四个候选答案,和一个正确的标签. 顺序原因 任务使用分组的伪时段记录,允许时间分类,平面推理,以及有限的历史背景下的变化检测.

blocks.en: CivilBench has three distinctive features. 1) CivilBench emphasizes domain-specific engineering semantics: questions require understanding of structural components, material conditions, damage mechanisms, and safety implications rather than generic object recognition. 2) CivilBench contains engineering-oriented visual content from inspection and disaster scenarios, where images often include occlusions, irregular geometries, complex backgrounds, and subtle damage cues. 3) CivilBench stresses decision-relevant reasoning, including hazard inference, failure-cause analysis, explanation assessment, and repair suggestion. These features make CivilBench a targeted benchmark for evaluating whether VLMs can support practical civil engineering understanding, rather than merely performing surface-level visual recognition.
blocks.zh: Civil Bench有三种独特的特征. 1)Civil Bench强调特定域的工程语义:问题需要理解结构组件,物质条件,损害机制,以及安全影响而不是通用对象识别. 2)Civil Bench包含来自检查和灾难情景的面向工程的视觉内容,其中图像往往包括隐蔽,不规则的几何,复杂的背景,以及微妙的破坏提示. 3) Civil Bench强调与决策有关的推理,包括危险推论,故障原因分析,解释评估,以及修复建议. 这些特征使得Civil Bench成为评价VLM是否能够支持实用的土木工程理解,而不仅仅是进行地表级视觉识别的目标基准.

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Data Distribution and Task Composition
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 数据分配和任务构成

blocks.en: Figure 4: Sample distribution across CivilBench task categories and capability dimensions. Percentages are calculated within each category.
blocks.zh: 图 4:样本在民间奔驰任务类别和能力层面的分布. 百分比在每个类别内计算。

blocks.en: To provide a clearer understanding of the dataset composition, we visualize the distribution of tasks and dimensions across the three major categories, as shown in Figure 4 . For Category A (Sequential Reasoning Tasks), the dataset is relatively balanced across three sub-tasks, including classification (38.6%), ordinal reasoning (31.6%), and change detection (29.8%). This balanced design ensures that the evaluation does not bias toward a particular reasoning type, while still covering diverse forms of structured inference, including label prediction, relative ordering, and pairwise comparison.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,为了更清楚地了解数据集的构成,我们可视化三大类别的任务和维度分布。 就A类(相应合理任务)而言,数据集在三个次级任务中相对平衡,包括分类(38.6%)、正则推理(31.6%)和变化检测(29.8%)。 这种均衡的设计确保评价不会偏向某一特定的推理类型,同时仍然涵盖多种形式的结构推断,包括标签预测、相对顺序和对等比较。

blocks.en: For Category B (Image-based Structural Understanding), coarse counting and event existence represent larger shares, reflecting the importance of detecting and quantifying structural damage. Geometry classification and material identification are also well represented, highlighting spatial and material cues. Region-level grounding and category-based coverage have fewer samples due to their precise annotation requirements and greater construction difficulty.
blocks.zh: 对于B类(基于图像的结构理解),粗糙的计算和事件存在代表了更大的份额,反映了发现和量化结构损害的重要性. 几何分类和材料识别也有很好的体现,突出了空间和材料提示。 由于精确的注释要求和建筑难度较大,区域一级的地面和基于类别的覆盖面较少。

blocks.en: For Category C (Open-world Understanding), the dataset emphasizes high-level reasoning tasks, including hazard inference, image–text alignment, and explanation quality assessment, each with substantial samples. These tasks evaluate models’ ability to integrate visual evidence with domain knowledge for decision-oriented reasoning. Repair suggestion and cause reasoning have moderate sample sizes, reflecting their higher annotation costs.
blocks.zh: 对于C类(开放世界理解),数据集强调高层次的推理任务,包括危险推论、图像文本对齐和解释质量评估,每个都带有大量样本。 这些任务评价模型将视觉证据与领域知识相结合的能力,以便进行面向决定的推理。 修复建议和原因推理的样本尺寸适中,反映了其较高的注释成本.

blocks.en: CivilBench has a deliberately non-uniform distribution that reflects each task’s practical importance and annotation complexity, enabling realistic evaluation without over-representing simpler tasks.
blocks.zh: Civil Bench有意识地进行非统一分配,反映每项任务的实际重要性和说明的复杂性,从而能够进行现实的评价,同时又不过分代表较简单的任务。

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Image Resolution Distribution Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 图像分辨率分布分析

blocks.en: We further analyze the distribution of image resolutions in CivilBench. As shown in Figure 4.1 , both Image-based Structural Understanding and Open-world Understanding cover a wide range of image resolutions, with most widths between approximately 300 and 1200 pixels. Open-world Understanding includes more high-resolution images, including samples exceeding 2000 pixels, reflecting its more complex scenes and richer visual details. Image-based Structural Understanding is more concentrated but still covers diverse visual conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析Civil Bench中图像分辨率的分布. 如图4.1所示,基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解都涵盖了广泛的图像分辨率,大部分宽度在大约300到1200像素之间. 开放世界理解(Open-world understanding)包括更高分辨率的图像,包括超过2000像素的样本,反映了其更复杂的场景和更丰富的视觉细节. 基于图像的结构理解较为集中,但仍涵盖多种视觉条件.

blocks.en: At the dimension level, Coarse Counting and Event Existence mainly use lower-resolution images, where global scene information is sufficient. Detail-oriented tasks, such as Geometry Pattern Classification , Material Category Identification , and Image-based Repair Suggestion , generally require higher resolutions. Meanwhile, Hazard Inference and Image-Text Explanation Quality Assessment span a broader range, reflecting their reliance on both visual and contextual information. Overall, this diverse resolution distribution represents realistic engineering scenarios and reduces scale-specific overfitting.
blocks.zh: 在维度层面,粗糙的计数和事件存在主要使用分辨率较低的图像,全球场景信息就足够了. 详细导向的任务,如几何模式分类,材料类识别,以及基于图像的修复建议,一般需要更高的分辨率. 同时,危险推论和图像文本解释质量评估范围更广,反映了对视觉和背景信息的依赖。 总体而言,这种多样的分辨率分布代表了现实的工程情景,减少了特有规模的过度调整.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
This section evaluates the performance of 17 representative VLMs on CivilBench. We first describe the experimental settings and benchmarking baselines, followed by the overall results and performance comparisons across different capability dimensions.
Finally, we further analyze the observed performance gaps and the main challenges faced by current VLMs.
blocks.zh:
本节评价了17个代表性VLMs在Civil Bench上的表现. 我们首先描述了试验设置和基准基线,然后是总体结果和不同能力层面的业绩比较。
最后,我们进一步分析了观察到的性能差距和当前自愿活动所面临的主要挑战。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We adopt a unified evaluation framework to ensure fair and reproducible comparison across different models, while allowing task-specific protocols tailored to distinct reasoning requirements. All models are evaluated using their official checkpoints without task-specific fine-tuning, and share identical input formats, prompt templates, parsing rules, and evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们采用一个统一的评价框架,以确保在不同模式之间进行公平和可复制的比较,同时允许根据不同的推理要求制定具体任务协议。 所有模式都使用其官方检查站进行评价,没有针对具体任务的微调,共享相同的输入格式、即时模板、解析规则和评价指标。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics . Across all tasks, we report accuracy as the primary evaluation metric, defined as the proportion of correctly predicted answers. In addition, we compute the average score ( Avg ) across different task dimensions to reflect overall performance consistency, and the total score ( Total ) as an aggregated indicator of model performance on the full benchmark. These metrics provide a concise yet informative assessment of model capability across diverse reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度 在所有任务中,我们报告准确性作为主要评价指标,定义为正确预测答案的比例。 此外,我们还计算不同任务层面的平均得分(Avg),以反映总体业绩的一致性,并计算总得分(Attal),作为全面基准上模式业绩的综合指标。 这些衡量标准对不同推理任务的模型能力进行了简明而翔实的评估。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Image resolution distribution in CivilBench across (top) task categories and (bottom) fine-grained capability dimensions.
blocks.zh: 图5:Civil Bench的图像分辨率分布,跨越(顶级)任务类别和(底级)精细能力维度.

blocks.en: We evaluate Image-based Structural Understanding and Open-world Understanding using single-choice MC-VQA tasks. Each sample includes an image, a natural-language question, and four candidate answers. Models are instructed to return exactly one uppercase letter from {A, B, C, D}, without explanation. A rule-based parser extracts predictions, while incorrectly formatted outputs are marked as invalid.
blocks.zh: 我们利用单一选择MC-VQA任务来评价基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解. 每个样本包括一个图像,一个自然语言问题,以及四个候选答案. 模型被指示从{A,B,C,D}返回一个精确的大写字母,而无需解释. 基于规则的解析器提取预测,而格式错误的输出则被标记为无效.

blocks.en: Sequential Reasoning tasks . For Sequential reasoning tasks, we adopt a few-shot in-context learning setting, where each sample is formulated as a structured reasoning problem derived from tabular or statistical data. Each instance consists of a set of context examples (input–label pairs) and a query set, and models are required to infer the underlying mapping rule before making predictions on unseen inputs. This setting evaluates the ability of models to perform structured reasoning under limited observations.
blocks.zh: 顺序理性任务 。 对于顺序推理任务,我们采用几个镜头的内在文字学习设置,将每个样本编成一个结构化推理问题,来源于表格或统计数据. 每个实例包括一组上下文实例(输入-标签对)和一组查询,需要模型在对无形输入进行预测之前先推断基本绘图规则。 这种设置评价模型在有限观察下进行结构化推理的能力.

blocks.en: We consider three types of sequential reasoning tasks:
blocks.zh: 我们认为有三种顺序推理任务:

blocks.en: 1) Classification. Models are provided with several input–label examples and are required to predict the label of a test input. The label space is explicitly defined in the prompt, and models must output a single valid label.
blocks.zh: (1) 分类。 为模型提供了几个输入-标签示例,并且需要预测测试输入的标签. 标签空间在提示中被明确定义,模型必须输出一个单一有效的标签.

blocks.en: 2) Ordinal reasoning. Models are required to infer latent scoring rules from context examples and identify the relative ordering among multiple candidates. Specifically, models must predict both the maximum and minimum indices within a candidate set. Outputs are constrained to structured formats ( e.g. , MAX_INDEX and MIN_INDEX ), and only valid index predictions are accepted.
blocks.zh: 2) 标准推理. 模型需要从上下文实例中推断潜在的评分规则,并确定多个候选人的相对顺序。 具体地说,模型必须预测一套候选人中的最高指数和最低指数。 产出受结构化格式的限制(如MAX_INDEX和MIND_INDEX),只有有效的指数预测被接受.

blocks.en: 3) Change detection. Models are asked to compare candidates and determine which one reflects a more severe condition based on inferred patterns. Similar to ordinal reasoning, predictions are restricted to local indices and validated through rule-based parsing.
blocks.zh: (3) 变化探测。 要求模型对候选人进行比较,并根据推断的模式确定哪一种情况更严重。 类似于平面推理,预测仅限于局部指数,并通过基于规则的解析验证.

blocks.en: To reduce stochastic variability and ensure consistent outputs, generation length is restricted, and decoding settings are fixed across all models.
blocks.zh: 为了减少扭曲的变异性并确保产出的一致性,生成长度受到限制,在所有模型中固定解码设置.

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarking Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en: We evaluate a diverse set of representative VLMs, including both open-source and closed-source models with different architectures, parameter scales, and training strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了一套具有代表性的VLM,包括具有不同架构、参数尺度和培训战略的开源模型和闭源模型。

blocks.en:
Open Source VLMs. We include several widely used open-source models, including MiniCPM-V [ 52 ] , a lightweight multimodal model designed for efficient visual reasoning; Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, which are part of the Qwen-VL series with strong multimodal alignment capabilities [ 4 ] ; InternVL and its variants (InternVL3-1B and InternVL3_5-14B), which focus on scaling vision-language pretraining for improved perception and reasoning [ 13 ] ; LLaVA-OneVision-7B, a unified multimodal model based on the LLaVA framework [ 29 ] ; and Phi-3.5-Vision, a compact vision-language model with competitive performance at small scale [ 1 ] .
We also include Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 5 ] , a more recent version with improved reasoning ability, as well as DeepSeek-VL2 [ 48 ] , which emphasizes multimodal reasoning and instruction-following capabilities.
In addition, Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503 [ 41 ] is evaluated as a strong open-source LLM baseline with extended reasoning capacity.
blocks.zh:
开源VLMs. 我们包括几种广泛使用的开源模型,包括MiniCPM-V[52],一种为高效视觉推理设计的轻量级多式联运模型;Qun2.5-VL-7B和Qun2.5-VL-3B-Instruct,它们是具有强大多式联运配合能力的Qun-VL系列的一部分[4];InternVL及其变体(InternVL3B和InternVL3_5-14B),其重点是为增强认知和推理而扩大视觉语言预训[13];LLaVA-OneVision-7B,一种基于LLAVA框架的统一多式联运模型[29];以及Phi-3.5-Vision,一种具有小规模竞争力的视觉语言模型[1].
我们还包括Qune3-VL-8B-Instructionct [5],这个更新版本的推理能力得到提高,以及DeepSeek-VL2 [48],它强调多式联运推理和指令跟踪能力.
此外,Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503[41]被评价为具有扩展推理能力的强开源LLM基线.

blocks.en: Closed Source VLMs. We further include several closed-source VLMs with strong multimodal capabilities, including Qwen-VL-Plus, a high-performance commercial variant of the Qwen-VL series [ 47 ] , GPT-4.1-mini, a lightweight yet capable multimodal model, GPT-4.1, which serves as a strong baseline with advanced reasoning and multimodal understanding capabilities [ 35 ] , GPT-5-mini, an efficient reasoning-oriented multimodal model with improved generalization and visual reasoning ability, GPT-5, the latest flagship multimodal model from OpenAI [ 42 ] , and Gemini-2.5-Pro [ 15 ] , Google’s flagship multimodal model with advanced visual understanding, long-context reasoning, and strong performance across diverse multimodal tasks.
blocks.zh: 闭源VLMs. 我们进一步包括几个具有强大多式联运能力的封闭源代码VLM,包括Quen-VL-Plus,Quen-VL系列的高性能商业变体[47],GPT-4.1-mini,轻量级但有能力的多式联运模型GPT-4.1,GPT-4.1,作为具有先进推理和多式联运能力的强基线[35],GPT-5-mini,一个具有更高通用性和视觉推理能力的高效推理导向的多式联运模型,GPT-5,OpenAI[42]的最新旗舰多式联运模型,以及Gemini-2.5-Pro[15],Google具有高级视觉理解的旗舰多式联运模型,长文推理,以及不同多式联运任务的强性能。

blocks.en: These models together provide comprehensive coverage of different model families, scales, and design paradigms, enabling a systematic comparison of their performance on CivilBench.
blocks.zh: 这些模型共同全面覆盖了不同的模范家庭、尺度和设计范式,从而能够系统地比较它们在Civil Bench上的绩效。

blocks.en: 4.3 Results and Observations
blocks.zh: 4.3 结果和意见

blocks.en: Table 2: Performance comparison of different VLMs on CivilBench (%). The best result in each column is highlighted in bold. A1: Classification, A2: Ordinal Reasoning, and A3: Change Detection, respectively; B: Image-based Structural Understanding; C: Open-world Understanding. “Avg” represents the capability-balanced average accuracy across all evaluated dimensions, whereas “Total” represents the distribution-weighted overall accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表2:关于民用奔驰不同自愿地雷的绩效比较(%)。 每栏的最佳结果以黑体突出。 A1:分类,A2:正态理性,和A3:变化检测,分别是;B:基于图像的结构理解;C:开放世界理解. “Avg”代表所有评价层面的能力平衡平均准确度,而“总计”则代表分配加权总体准确度。

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports the performance of representative vision-language models on CivilBench across different task categories, including Sequential Reasoning Tasks (A1–A3), Image-based Structural Understanding (B), and Open-world Understanding (C), together with the capability-balanced average accuracy (Avg) and the distribution-weighted total accuracy (Total).
Figure 4.3 further compares the capability-balanced Avg score with the distribution-weighted Total score across all evaluated models. The gap between the two scores is mainly driven by the larger Image-based Structural Understanding and Open-world Understanding subsets, whose sample sizes give them greater influence on the distribution-weighted Total score.
blocks.zh:
表2按不同任务类别,包括顺序理性任务(A1-A3)、基于图像的结构理解(B)和开放世界理解(C),以及能力平衡平均精度(Avg)和分配加权总精度(总),报告具有代表性的 " 民用奔驰 " 视觉语言模型的业绩。
图4.3 进一步比较能力平衡 Avg的得分与所有被评价模型的分布加权总得分. 两个分数之间的差距主要由更大的基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解子集驱动,其样本大小使其对分配加权总分的影响力更大.

blocks.en:
Overall, Avg and Total scores are positively correlated but capture distinct performance aspects. Total scores are generally higher because larger, relatively easier image-based and open-world categories dominate the evaluated subset, potentially masking weaknesses in smaller, reasoning-intensive dimensions. The color coding in Figure 4.3 makes this effect more explicit. Models in the upper-right region perform strongly overall but remain limited in Ordinal Reasoning, showing that high aggregate accuracy does not imply balanced civil-engineering reasoning. Gains often stem from visual recognition, language priors, and open-world knowledge, while ordinal reasoning remains a bottleneck. Thus, Avg reveals cross-dimensional imbalance, whereas Total reflects performance under CivilBench’s sample distribution.
To support the following capability-level discussion, Table 3 further summarizes the results across dimensions, including sample share, mean accuracy, score range, open–closed model gap, and the number of models falling below or above key accuracy thresholds.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,Avg和Total的分数是正相关联的,但记录了不同的业绩方面。 总分一般较高,因为较大、相对容易的图像类和开放世界类在所评价的子集中占主导地位,有可能掩盖较小、推理密集型的弱点。 图4.3中的颜色编码使这种效果更加明显. 右上角区域的模式总体表现强劲,但在标准理性中仍然有限,表明高总精度并不意味着平衡的土木工程推理. 收益往往来自视觉识别,语言前科,和开放世界的知识,而平面推理仍然是瓶颈. 因此, Avg揭示了跨维不平衡,而Total则反映了Civil Bench样本分布下的性能.
为支持下列能力层面的讨论,表3进一步总结了不同层面的成果,包括样本份额、平均准确度、得分范围、开放式封闭模型差距以及低于或超过关键精确阈值的模型数量。

blocks.en:
Performance discrepancy across task categories. Open-world Understanding is the strongest category for most models, with an average accuracy of 80.67%; 14 out of 17 models score above 80%.
By contrast, Ordinal Reasoning is consistently difficult.
Its average accuracy is only 23.79%, and even the best model, Gemini-2.5-pro, reaches only 37.78%.
Most models remain below 30% on this dimension.
The gap suggests that current VLMs are much better at answering visually grounded or knowledge-aligned questions than at recovering relative numerical relations from a few examples.
blocks.zh:
各任务类别的业绩差异。 开放世界理解是大多数模型最强的类别,平均精度为80.67%;17个模型中有14个得分高于80%.
相比之下,通常的理性总是很困难。
它的平均精度只有23.79%,甚至最好的模型双子座-2.5-pro也只达到37.78%.
大多数模型在这一方面仍然低于30%。
差距表明,目前的虚拟内容报告比从几个例子中恢复相对数字关系要好得多,更能回答视线问题或知识问题。

blocks.en:
Sequential Reasoning as a bottleneck. The three sequential reasoning tasks show different difficulty levels.
Classification is relatively easier, with an average accuracy of 63.53% and a best score of 74.55% by GPT-4.1-mini.
Change Detection is harder, averaging 50.86%, with GPT-5 reaching 67.06%.
Ordinal Reasoning is the clear bottleneck.
Its best score is still lower than the average accuracy of most other dimensions.
This means the main challenge is not simply reading sequential inputs, but inferring an ordering rule from very limited observations.
blocks.zh:
序理为瓶颈. 三个顺序推理任务显示不同的难度级别.
分类比较容易,平均精度为63.53%,最佳分数为74.55%的GPT-4.1-mini.
变化检测更难,平均50.86%,GPT-5达到67.06%.
常规理性是明显的瓶颈.
它的最佳得分仍然低于大多数其他维度的平均准确度.

Moderate performance in structural understanding. Image-based Structural Understanding falls between sequential reasoning and open-world tasks.

High accuracy in Open-world tasks. Open-world Understanding is much easier for current models.
Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GPT-5 both reach 88.28%, and several other models exceed 85%. However, a high Open-world Understanding task score does not always mean balanced performance. For example, Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct obtains 84.79% on Open-world Understanding, but its Avg is only 33.44% because it performs poorly on the Sequential Reasoning tasks. 高精度的开放世界任务. 对目前的模型来说,开放世界理解要容易得多。

Importance of distribution-aware evaluation. “Avg” and “Total” provide complementary performance views.

As shown by the Share column in Table 3 , Image-based Structural Understanding and Open-world Understanding account for 29.42% and 41.26% of the final evaluated subset, respectively.

Overall observation. Gemini-2.5-pro achieves the best overall results, with an Avg of 63.96% and a Total of 71.09%.

CivilBench reveals a clear gap between models’ performance on perception-oriented or knowledge-aligned tasks and their ability to conduct structured reasoning for engineering analysis.

blocks.en: 4.4 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 进一步分析

blocks.en: In this section, we further analyze model behavior on CivilBench and discuss what the results reveal about current VLMs in civil-engineering scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进一步分析Civil Bench上的模型行为,并讨论结果揭示了当前土木工程情景中的VLM.

blocks.en: Capability-dependent difficulty hierarchy. Table 2 shows a clear capability-dependent difficulty hierarchy. Open-world Understanding tasks achieve the strongest overall performance, while Ordinal Reasoning tasks are consistently the most challenging dimension. Across all evaluated models, the average accuracy on Ordinal Reasoning tasks is only about 23.8 % 23.8\% , and even the best model reaches only 37.78 % 37.78\% . This is in sharp contrast to Open-world Understanding tasks, whose average accuracy is about 80.7 % 80.7\% and where several models exceed 85 % 85\% accuracy.
blocks.zh: 能力依赖难度等级. 表2显示一个明显依赖能力的困难等级。 开放世界理解任务实现最强的整体性能,而标准理性任务始终是最具挑战性的方面. 在所有被评价的模型中,普通理性任务的平均准确度只有23.8%,甚至最好的模型也只有37.78%的37.78%。 这与"开放世界理解"任务形成鲜明对比,其平均精度约为80.7%80.7\%,多个模型超过85%85\%的精度.

blocks.en:
This gap suggests that current VLMs are not uniformly weak on civil-engineering tasks. Instead, their failures are concentrated in tasks that require structured comparison, ordinal judgment, and stage-wise reasoning.
Open-world Understanding tasks can often be solved by combining visual recognition with broad world knowledge and language priors.
In contrast, Ordinal Reasoning tasks require models to compare multiple observations and infer relative severity or risk levels, which cannot be reliably solved by recognizing isolated visual or textual cues.
blocks.zh:
这一差距表明,在土木工程任务方面,目前的VLM并不一致。 相反,它们的失败集中在需要有条理的比较、正常的判断和阶段性推理的任务上。
开放世界 理解任务往往可以通过将视觉识别与广泛的世界知识和语言前身相结合来解决.
相比之下,普通理性任务需要模型来比较多个观测结果,并推断相对严重性或风险水平,通过识别孤立的视觉或文字提示无法可靠地解决.

blocks.en: Figure 7 highlights clear difficulty differences across capability dimensions, showing model accuracy distributions and sample sizes. Ordinal Reasoning has the lowest mean accuracy and upper performance bound despite not being the smallest subset. Its best-performing model, Gemini-2.5-pro, reaches only 37.78%, indicating an intrinsic difficulty in inferring ordinal relations from sparse structured evidence rather than an effect of sample imbalance. In contrast, Open-world Understanding has the largest sample size and highest average performance, with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GPT-5 jointly achieving 88.28%, suggesting stronger alignment with pretrained knowledge and language priors. The leading model also varies by dimension: GPT-4.1-mini leads Classification, Gemini-2.5-pro leads Ordinal Reasoning and Image-based Structural Understanding, GPT-5 leads Change Detection, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GPT-5 tie in Open-world Understanding. These varying rankings show that aggregate scores can obscure capability-specific strengths and weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 图7突出显示不同能力维度之间的明显难度差异,显示模型精度分布和样本大小. 正常理性尽管不是最小的子集,但平均准确度最低,性能最高。 它的性能最好的模型双子座-2.5-pro仅达到37.78%,表明从稀少的结构化证据推断正统关系存在内在困难,而不是样本失衡的影响. 相比之下,"开放世界理解"的样本尺寸最大,平均性能最高,Qun2.5-VL-7B和GPT-5联合达到88.28%,表明与预训知识和语言前科更加一致. 领先模型也因维度而异:GPT-4.1-mini线索分类,双子座2.5-pro线索Ordinal Reasoning和基于图像的结构理解,GPT-5引领变化检测,以及Qwen2.5-VL-7B和GPT-5在开放世界理解中的捆绑. 这些不同的排名表明,总分可以掩盖能力特有的优缺点。

blocks.en: Why are Ordinal Reasoning and Change Detection difficult? As summarized in Table 4 , these tasks require models to infer an unknown ranking or change rule from only four labeled examples and then apply it to a new instance. The benchmark draws Ordinal Reasoning from 10 source schemas and Change Detection from 17, while each instance contains an average of 8.8 and 15.9 unique fields, respectively. Models must therefore identify the fields relevant to the target relation with minimal supervision. This challenge differs from standard classification because 88.9% of Ordinal Reasoning labels and 94.1% of Change Detection labels are numeric, requiring models to derive implicit relations rather than recognize predefined categories. Noisy or partially observable relationships and repeated labels further reduce the information available for distinguishing fine-grained ordinal or temporal.
blocks.zh: 为什么常态理性和变化检测困难? 如表4所概述,这些任务需要模型推断出一个未知的排名或从仅有四个标注的例子中更改规则,然后将其应用到一个新的实例中. 该基准从10个源代码和17个变化检测中得出了标准理由,而每个实例分别包含平均8.8和15.9个独特的领域。 因此,模型必须确定与目标关系有关的领域,同时尽量不进行监督。 这个挑战与标准分类不同,因为88.9%的常态理性标签和94.1%的变异检测标签是数字化的,要求模型得出隐含的关系,而不是识别预定义的类别. 噪音或部分可见的关系和重复的标签进一步减少了可用于区分细纹或时间的信息。

blocks.en:
In addition to this regression-derived target burden, some samples also involve incomplete or knowledge-heavy evidence, as illustrated in Figure 4.4 .
Here, event-record cues refer to explicit mentions of real disasters or infrastructure events, missing cells indicate incomplete structured records, and long text fields introduce additional information-filtering demands.
blocks.zh:
除了这种回归产生的目标负担之外,如图4.4所示,一些样本还涉及不完整或知识重的证据。
这里,事件记录提示是指明确提及真实的灾难或基础设施事件,缺失的单元格表示不完整的结构化记录,长文本字段引入额外的信息过滤需求.

blocks.en: For such cases, correct prediction may require more than local tabular evidence: models may need to combine sparse numerical reasoning with civil-engineering domain knowledge, parametric knowledge acquired during pretraining, or external historical context. Therefore, the difficulty of these two dimensions reflects a joint challenge of data-efficient numerical rule induction, robust relational comparison, and knowledge-grounded decision making.
blocks.zh: 对于这类情况,正确的预测可能需要的不仅仅是当地表列证据:模型可能需要将稀有的数字推理与土木工程领域知识,在预训期间获得的参数化知识,或外部历史背景相结合. 因此,这两个方面的困难反映了一个共同的挑战,即数据效率高的数值规则诱导、强有力的关系比较和以知识为基础的决策。

blocks.zh: 发行意识评价.

blocks.en:
CivilBench also highlights the importance of distinguishing between distribution-weighted and capability-balanced evaluation. Let n k n_{k} denote the number of samples in capability dimension k k , and let N N be the total number of samples. The Total score can be interpreted as: Total = ∑ k n k N ​ Acc k , \mathrm{Total}=\sum_{k}\frac{n_{k}}{N}\mathrm{Acc}_{k}, (1) whereas Avg assigns equal weight to each evaluated capability: Avg = 1 K ​ ∑ k Acc k . \mathrm{Avg}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k}\mathrm{Acc}_{k}. (2) This distinction is important because the evaluated subset is not uniformly distributed across dimensions. Image-based Structural Understanding and Open-world Understanding contain 286 and 401 samples, respectively, accounting for 70.7% of the final evaluated subset, whereas Ordinal Reasoning contains only 90 samples. As a result, Total accuracy is more strongly affected by performance on the larger perception-driven and open-world categories.
For example, Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct obtains a low capability-balanced Avg of 33.44%, but its Total score rises to 51.95%, mainly because it performs much better on Image-based Structural Understanding and Open-world Understanding than on the sequential reasoning dimensions.
Similarly, InternVL3-1B and DeepSeek VL2 have comparable Avg scores, 45.63% and 46.73%, but their Total scores differ noticeably, 55.33% versus 49.27%, largely due to the much higher Open-world Understanding accuracy of InternVL3-1B.

blocks.en:
Figure 4.3 further illustrates that models with similar Avg scores may obtain different Total scores because their strengths are distributed differently across capability dimensions. In particular, strong performance on Open-world Understanding can improve Total accuracy, but it does not necessarily indicate robust sequential reasoning.
For instance, Qwen2.5-VL-7B reaches 88.28% on Open-world Understanding and 63.07% in Total accuracy, while its Ordinal Reasoning accuracy remains only 26.67%. Therefore, the gap between Avg and Total provides a useful diagnostic signal: it reveals whether a model is broadly balanced or mainly benefits from high performance on the dominant task categories.
blocks.zh:
图4.3进一步说明: Avg分数可能获得不同的总分数,因为其长处在能力层面的分布不同. 特别是,在开放世界理解方面的有力表现可以提高总的准确性,但并不一定表明有力的顺序推理。
例如,Quen2.5-VL-7B在开放世界理解方面达到88.28%,在总精确度方面达到63.07%,而其普通理性准确度仍然只有26.67%。 因此,Avg和Total之间的差距提供了一个有用的诊断信号:它揭示一个模型是大体平衡的还是主要得益于在主要任务类别上的高性能.

blocks.en: Methodological implications. These findings indicate that improving CivilBench performance requires more than stronger visual perception or large-scale instruction tuning. Sequential Reasoning may benefit from table-aware reasoning, temporal state tracking, ordinal ranking, pairwise comparison, and cross-observation consistency checking, supported by ranking-based supervision, preference modeling, programmatic numerical reasoning, and uncertainty-aware prediction rather than standard multiple-choice classification alone. Retrieval augmentation may also be needed for historical disasters and region-specific infrastructure events when relevant evidence is absent from the prompt. For Image-based Structural Understanding, models require explicit structural representations, including region-level grounding, component-aware features, damage localization, and geometry-sensitive pretraining, because engineering decisions depend on where damage occurs, which components are affected, and how damage patterns relate to material and structural behavior.
blocks.zh: 所涉方法学问题。 这些调查结果表明,改善Civil Bench性能需要的不仅仅是更强的视觉感知或大规模指令调谐. 顺序理性可能得益于表意识推理,时间状态跟踪,官阶排名,双向比较,以及交叉观测一致性检查,辅以基于排名的监督,偏好模型,方案数字推理,以及不确定性意识预测,而不是仅标准多选择分类. 在缺乏相关证据的情况下,可能还需要对历史灾难和特定区域基础设施事件进行检索。 对于基于图像的结构理解,模型需要明确的结构表示,包括区域一级的地面,组件意识特征,损坏局部化,以及几何灵敏的预训,因为工程决策取决于损害发生地点,哪些组件受到影响,损害模式如何与物质和结构行为相关.

blocks.en: 4.5 Enhancing Numerical Reasoning with Priors and Web Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.5 增加前科和网络检索的数字理由

blocks.en: The preceding analysis reveals a key limitation of current vision-language models in Ordinal Reasoning (A2) and Change Detection (A3): they struggle to reliably identify numerical relationships from sparse labeled observations, particularly when relevant event-specific knowledge is absent from the input. This suggests that their numerical reasoning remains sensitive to the availability of explicit guidance and external evidence. To further investigate this limitation, we conduct supplementary experiments with GPT-5-mini using two configurations: prior-guided inference and retrieval-augmented prior-guided inference . These experiments examine whether explicit numerical priors and access to external knowledge can alleviate the observed difficulties without modifying the benchmark instances or increasing the number of labeled support examples.
blocks.zh: 前面的分析揭示了当前在标准理性(A2)和变化检测(A3)中视觉语言模型的关键局限性:它们努力从少量的标注观测中可靠地识别数值关系,特别是在输入中缺少相关事件特定知识时. 这表明,它们的数字推理对于提供明确的指导和外部证据仍然敏感。 为了进一步调查这一限制,我们使用GPT-5-mini进行补充实验,使用两种配置:前导推论和后导推论。 这些实验研究了明确的数字前科和获取外部知识能否在不修改基准实例或增加标签支持实例的情况下缓解所观察到的困难。

blocks.en: Experimental setup. Both configurations are evaluated on the original 90 A2 and 85 A3 instances, each with four labeled support observations. All benchmark inputs and annotations remain unchanged, and predictions are evaluated using the original parser and accuracy metric, with invalid outputs counted as incorrect. The main-experiment GPT-5-mini scores (26.67% for A2 and 62.35% for A3) serve as the baseline. As the configurations were evaluated in separate runs, performance differences are reported descriptively without claims of statistical significance or isolated causal effects.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 这两种配置在最初的90 A2 和 85 A3 实例上都得到评价,每个实例都有四个标注支持观察. 所有基准投入和说明保持不变,预测使用原始解析器和准确度衡量标准加以评价,无效产出被计算为不正确。 主实验GPT-5-mini分数(A2为26.67%,A3为62.35%)作为基准. 由于对组合进行了单独评价,因此在报告业绩差异时没有说明统计意义或孤立的因果关系。

four examples. Prior-guided inference additionally identifies the target indicator, such as
earthquake magnitude, event duration, or estimated financial loss, and specifies
units when these are established by the available information.
It also provides schema-specific numerical priors. Two examples relevant to
disaster-risk assessment and event-duration analysis are: R i WRI \displaystyle R_{i}^{\mathrm{WRI}} = E i ​ V i 100 , \displaystyle=\frac{E_{i}V_{i}}{100}, (3) T i event \displaystyle T_{i}^{\mathrm{event}} = ( t i end − t i start ) days . \displaystyle=\bigl(t_{i}^{\mathrm{end}}-t_{i}^{\mathrm{start}}\bigr)_{\mathrm{days}}. Here, E i E_{i} and V i V_{i} denote the exposure and vulnerability percentages of record i i , respectively, and R i WRI R_{i}^{\mathrm{WRI}} represents its World Risk Index. T i event T_{i}^{\mathrm{event}} denotes the event duration in days, calculated from the recorded start and end dates. For the GDP schema, the product of per-capita GDP and total population is also considered as an arithmetic prior.
These priors are supplied only for the corresponding target schemas and only
when they agree with the current instance’s support labels under predefined
tolerances. No query target values are supplied or calculated for inclusion
in the prompt. Additional instructions discourage unsupported deterministic
rules, distinguish missing values from zero, and require consistent comparison
across candidates. For A3, the prompt explicitly follows the implemented
evaluation objective: selecting the candidate with the larger target value.

The retrieval process uses available event names, dates, locations, coordinates, identifiers, and record URLs to search for relevant historical records or indicator definitions. The model is instructed to prioritize primary sources and assess event identity, temporal coverage, and indicator definitions before incorporating retrieved information.

blocks.en: Results and interpretation. As shown in Table 5 , prior-guided inference improves GPT-5-mini’s accuracy from 26.67% to 35.56% on A2 (32/90) and from 62.35% to 68.24% on A3 (58/85). Adding web retrieval further increases accuracy to 46.67% (42/90) and 71.76% (61/85), respectively. The largest gain occurs in A2, with a 20.00 percentage-point improvement over the reported baseline, indicating that sparse numerical reasoning is particularly sensitive to additional guidance and evidence.
blocks.zh: 果与释. 如表5所示,前导推论提高了GPT-5-mini的准确度,从A2(32/90)的26.67%提高到35.56%,从A3(58/85)的62.35%提高到68.24%。 加上网络检索,准确率分别提高到46.67%(42/90)和71.76%(61/85)。 最大的增益发生在A2,比报告的基线提高20.00个百分点,表明数字推理很少,对额外的指导和证据特别敏感。

blocks.en:
However, the benefit of retrieval is not uniform. Compared with Method 1, retrieval corrects 20 previously incorrect A2 predictions but also changes 10 correct predictions to incorrect ones; the corresponding numbers for A3 are 10 and 7. At the schema level, earthquake-depth accuracy increases from 1/10 to 6/10, whereas financial-loss and resilience-score accuracy decreases from 1/5 to 0/5 and from 4/10 to 2/10, respectively. These contrasting outcomes indicate that access to external information alone does not ensure better predictions.
A closer examination of the retrieval records provides further insight. In 32 A2 instances where the retrieval stage reports identifying a specific record containing a target value, correct predictions increase from 12 to 22. In the remaining 58 instances, both methods correctly answer 20 cases in aggregate.
While the retrieved matches have not been fully verified, the observed improvements demonstrate the potential of external knowledge to support prediction from sparse observations.

更仔细地审查检索记录,可进一步了解情况。 在32个A2中,检索阶段报告确定了包含目标值的具体记录,正确的预测从12个增加到22个。 在其余58个案例中,这两种方法都正确回答了总共20个案例。
虽然尚未充分核实已检索的匹配情况,但观察到的改进表明,外部知识有潜力支持从稀少的观测中作出的预测。

blocks.en: Implications. These findings expose two related limitations in sparse numerical reasoning: difficulty inferring reliable relationships from limited observations and difficulty using external evidence consistently. Explicit priors and retrieval can alleviate these limitations, but their effectiveness depends on the underlying target and the quality of evidence alignment. Importantly, the observed gains reflect improved prediction under additional guidance and knowledge access, not necessarily stronger intrinsic numerical reasoning, since retrieved records may directly contain the target values.
blocks.zh: 影响。 这些结论暴露了在数量稀少的推理方面的两个相关局限性:难以从有限的观察中推断出可靠的关系;难以一致地利用外部证据。 明确的前科和检索可以减轻这些局限性,但其有效性取决于基本目标和证据一致性的质量。 重要的是,所观察到的成果反映了在更多的指导和知识获取下改进了预测,不一定更强有力的内在数字推理,因为检索的记录可能直接包含目标值。

blocks.en: 5 Discussions and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Contribution to the community. CivilBench advances civil-engineering VLM evaluation from generic image–text understanding to capability-level diagnosis, revealing weaknesses in sparse numerical reasoning, ordinal comparison, and knowledge-grounded decision making. Supplementary experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can improve prediction accuracy, but retrieval may also introduce errors when evidence is poorly aligned with the target. These findings distinguish access to information from the ability to use it reliably. For VLM researchers, CivilBench emphasizes domain-specific diagnostics beyond aggregate accuracy; for civil engineers, it provides a basis for assessing model readiness for inspection, risk assessment, and decision support.
blocks.zh: 对社区的贡献。 Civil Bench将土木工程VLM评价从通用图像理解推进到能力层面的诊断,揭示了稀有数字推理、平面比较和以知识为基础的决策方面的弱点。 补充实验显示,数字前科和外部知识可以提高预测的准确性,但当证据与目标不匹配时检索也可能引入错误. 这些调查结果将获得信息与可靠使用信息的能力区分开来。 对于VLM研究者来说,Civil Bench强调超出聚合精度的专有领域诊断;对于土木工程师来说,它为评估检查的模型准备状态,风险评估和决策支持提供了基础.

blocks.en:
Limitations. CivilBench’s multiple-choice format simplifies real engineering practice , where explanations, evidence, and uncertainty are essential, while its pseudo-temporal sequences assess sparse structured reasoning rather than conventional time-series forecasting . The supplementary experiments are limited to GPT-5-mini, and retrieval may directly provide target values rather than improve intrinsic reasoning. Future work should broaden structural types, damage modes, and regional hazards; incorporate component-level grounding, causal explanations; and distinguish closed-book reasoning from retrieval-augmented prediction.
CivilBench reveals persistent limitations of current VLMs in civil-engineering tasks, particularly in sequential reasoning, sparse numerical inference, and reliable use of domain-specific evidence.
Future work will expand the benchmark with more diverse engineering scenarios, fine-grained annotations, and open-ended tasks to further assess reasoning reliability and evidence-grounded decision-making.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a capability-oriented benchmark for evaluating vision-language models in civil and structural engineering. CivilBench organizes engineering tasks into three categories: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, enabling both overall performance evaluation and fine-grained capability diagnosis. Experiments across diverse VLMs reveal substantial performance gaps, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer relational, ordinal, and temporal patterns from sparse structured observations. Supplementary experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can improve prediction accuracy, although reliable use of retrieved evidence remains challenging. These findings indicate that strong visual recognition and general knowledge do not necessarily translate into reliable engineering reasoning. Addressing these limitations requires stronger structured reasoning and effective integration of domain knowledge. CivilBench provides a foundation for evaluating progress toward reliable multimodal decision support in civil engineering.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了Civil Bench,这是在民用和结构工程中评价视觉语言模型的面向能力的基准. Civil Bench将工程任务分为三类:序列理性,基于图像的结构理解,以及开放世界理解,从而既能进行整体性能评价,又能进行精细的能力诊断. 跨各种VLM的实验揭示了巨大的性能差距,序列理性逐渐成为一个主要瓶颈,特别是当模型必须推断出关联性,规律性,以及从稀少的结构观测得出的时间规律时. 补充实验显示,数字前科和外部知识可以提高预测的准确性,尽管可靠地使用所收集的证据仍然具有挑战性。 这些调查结果表明,强烈的视觉识别和一般知识并不一定转化为可靠的工程推理. 解决这些局限性需要更强有力的结构推理和有效整合域知识。 Civil Bench为评估在土木工程方面可靠的多式联运决策支持方面的进展奠定了基础。
